questions.question: What visualizations are included in the Idea Manager dashboard? (Choose THREE)

options.text: Top 10 ideas by votes (horizontal bar chart)

explanation.correct: The Idea Manager dashboard includes: Ideas by state (pie chart showing breakdown by state), Top 10 ideas by votes (horizontal bar chart based on up-votes), and Ideas trended by categories (line chart showing monthly trends). Incident and Change metrics are part of other applications.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Incident resolution times are part of ITSM dashboards, not Idea Manager
Change request volumes are part of Change Management dashboards, not Idea Manager

source.excerpt: Ideas by state - Pie chart. Top 10 ideas by votes - Horizontal bar chart. Ideas trended by categories - Line chart.
